description: Adds rows the person tells you about to a track, like a purchase they made in cash. Each row is an object of columns to values, by column key (from list_tracks) or by the column's name as the sheet shows it; dates as YYYY-MM-DD. All rows are written, or none: a value that doesn't fit its column, or a row a blocking rule keeps out, is refused with the reason. On the person's own tracks, give the row key column (rowKey in list_tracks) to update the row with that key instead of adding one. For an email or webhook body, use send_message instead, so the track's hacks read it.

example.description: true marks them as made-up example rows (Example in the Hack column), for a sheet you'll share as a template: they show it working, and the person removes them in one tap.

name: add_rows
title: Add rows
